blocks.text: Managing research tabs for urban planning

Urban planning requires juggling multiple sources. You might have a parcel map open in one tab and a zoning ordinance in another. Chrome tab groups are essential here. Right click any tab and choose Add tab to new group. Give it a name like Project Site A. This keeps your interface clean. You can collapse these groups when you focus on drafting reports.

Lazur works with Chrome to help you find information faster. When you look at a complex site plan or a long PDF report, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask for a summary. Lazur reads the page content and answers out loud. You do not need to scroll through pages of text to find the density requirements or setback rules.

When you need to collect data from municipal portals, you often encounter repetitive forms. Use Lazur to dictate information into these fields. Hold fn and speak clearly. This is faster than typing long addresses or site descriptions. If you are stuck on a complex web form, ask Lazur to point at the next required field. It will draw a circle on your screen to show you where to go.

blocks.caption: Chrome shortcuts and Lazur capabilities for planners

blocks.text: Urban planning tools like ArcGIS Online can be heavy on system resources. If Chrome feels slow, check your extensions. Go to Chrome > Settings > Extensions and remove ones you do not use. You can also clear site data for specific sites that are acting up. If a map portal fails to load, try opening an incognito window with ⌘ + ⇧ + N to see if it is a cache issue.

You spend a lot of time on administrative tasks. Research shows that professionals spend up to 36 percent of their time on admin work. Use Lazur to set reminders for public meetings or project deadlines. Just say, Remind me to upload the site plan at 3 PM. Lazur adds this to your Apple Reminders automatically. You stay in your flow without switching apps.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with GIS software on Mac?
faq.answer: Lazur helps you navigate the interface and provides information from the screen. It does not control GIS software or perform spatial analysis for you.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to fill out permit applications?
faq.answer: You can use Lazur to dictate text into the fields of a permit application. It helps you find the right fields by pointing at them on your screen.

faq.question: How do I speed up Chrome if it is slow?
faq.answer: Clear your cache, remove unused extensions, and close unnecessary tabs. You can also check if you are on the latest version of Chrome by going to Chrome > About Google Chrome.
